**Yes, alcohol can dehydrate you** . It acts as a diuretic by suppressing antidiuretic hormone (ADH, also called vasopressin), which tells your kidneys to retain water—causing you to lose more fluids through urine.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXX2qcvQnvX85kmpl9LO09a1mIhh2l3w_EEk2BUHywp4oBQT_0g5vSjF353EfH_hn_RsmvB7HcMLTPs2m-jnltgnE2bmm9FNZDBY5fpYqZOur0oGH-9n7AKblV68_hp0iBMUre8u8jXzOYwX-vpdnahiFqNag)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXX0QmvOtvjjQThWNShom_zcUjUE-kXOVUlHCzpemG7ZBdiHtYdrDoOSROPcfabkvOtIxNJQgNxRAcXD0JP2HBwWfVm0Am581w9e2p9Q0NHWj8CCfJm9NDdC8L3zL2eQD9pthYduMwXpaDZEjZYKztRxma0)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXX9b_7usm47XTJe182kDmhBAlJ-vrBjQq1AKUn83qvq-w68Qjr3yeQVJ7PgAIVRLV2RaHjd1uegdtAXItf2l5XJfk_Yi2JgZ7CJscXX1wTNtVnojfD4EfJbtO0aTwB0I1sGc_xuNkGwSvBnVPQT2Zb_Whm3Q3I4-etar4)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXnnr0taeM5PoPyEMVIDaZwpn_914dGRG7_thihF_EL3RFhVAbhD1PH7kAQurEnDQPWnze3MHQwOLTYhEiEVEkh1EVHl_T9FYWR9Evq3sG8t5nzDdW81c-VbI4_HYWQg6V)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXkx-uvBmeF3Kov_N6gyJTY0jWfYRRSQsz4DHfI5esxZBK7aHssmko9pxyf4YNdasn39NIzWVNKhkYu_XyeeqLCLKIB_NonWKa9C4u9tx6gz3R2C2AygOYUbwZUfvpD-wlB9iek8Dz)

### How It Happens

- **Increased urination:** Lower ADH levels mean your kidneys excrete more water instead of reabsorbing it.
- **Sweating and blood vessel changes:** Alcohol dilates blood vessels and can raise your heart rate, leading to extra fluid loss through sweat.
- **Diminished thirst cues:** It can blunt your awareness of thirst, making it easy to fall behind on fluids.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXnnr0taeM5PoPyEMVIDaZwpn_914dGRG7_thihF_EL3RFhVAbhD1PH7kAQurEnDQPWnze3MHQwOLTYhEiEVEkh1EVHl_T9FYWR9Evq3sG8t5nzDdW81c-VbI4_HYWQg6V)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXkx-uvBmeF3Kov_N6gyJTY0jWfYRRSQsz4DHfI5esxZBK7aHssmko9pxyf4YNdasn39NIzWVNKhkYu_XyeeqLCLKIB_NonWKa9C4u9tx6gz3R2C2AygOYUbwZUfvpD-wlB9iek8Dz)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXkuD6VqgvnOEZ2mwRCRzROe9W7dPwWkIKslKWZwmmw1YWn7asBFJnGbkk36c9Hn-gBv_SEAqKLx5anKIgAOvi0bIkFFBY0j7bB8FxcoiRHjMQNs1mhQJt4TcpeFjeki6h3FjmvpwXWK2LT_nY-P87iW-UNbrUIrSYQA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXibZYVqe2NOnEWrxrJQPjHnvhlFb9fbSahP741_KwCgjQWD_hw6zO_RyU-E4FpAlqJxSNPpiT7qfumt2QSrwso_ZdTfgXgQVQT2rs8RhzoN_RIlqtEeK7oDJR_ioa_dpzBdC7eFrHcmxaZ2MiGSegCSo1xEpXUF1zs8E)

### What Speeds Up Dehydration

- **Higher ABV and larger amounts:** Stronger drinks (like liquor or high-ABV drinks) and consuming more alcohol increase fluid loss. Very low-ABV beverages (such as non-alcoholic or low-alcohol beer) have much less of a dehydrating effect.
- **Empty stomach:** Without food, alcohol absorbs into your bloodstream faster.
- **Warm weather or fast drinking:** Heat adds sweat loss, and drinking quickly speeds up absorption.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXX9b_7usm47XTJe182kDmhBAlJ-vrBjQq1AKUn83qvq-w68Qjr3yeQVJ7PgAIVRLV2RaHjd1uegdtAXItf2l5XJfk_Yi2JgZ7CJscXX1wTNtVnojfD4EfJbtO0aTwB0I1sGc_xuNkGwSvBnVPQT2Zb_Whm3Q3I4-etar4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXX2qcvQnvX85kmpl9LO09a1mIhh2l3w_EEk2BUHywp4oBQT_0g5vSjF353EfH_hn_RsmvB7HcMLTPs2m-jnltgnE2bmm9FNZDBY5fpYqZOur0oGH-9n7AKblV68_hp0iBMUre8u8jXzOYwX-vpdnahiFqNag)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXibZYVqe2NOnEWrxrJQPjHnvhlFb9fbSahP741_KwCgjQWD_hw6zO_RyU-E4FpAlqJxSNPpiT7qfumt2QSrwso_ZdTfgXgQVQT2rs8RhzoN_RIlqtEeK7oDJR_ioa_dpzBdC7eFrHcmxaZ2MiGSegCSo1xEpXUF1zs8E)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXkx-uvBmeF3Kov_N6gyJTY0jWfYRRSQsz4DHfI5esxZBK7aHssmko9pxyf4YNdasn39NIzWVNKhkYu_XyeeqLCLKIB_NonWKa9C4u9tx6gz3R2C2AygOYUbwZUfvpD-wlB9iek8Dz)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXX7qgx6I9zLt1HHhgZ1IvYCZAf5oRM1dq4Vif85gzoE5cQi54VViLJRSlbkJENrfhZfib3IW1qeTM10v71cy_ao0eywSNHlvaPzNqxCu9mtZOrNcf_InWK5nsClIfGHDxNthpivwQ)

### Ways to Lower Your Risk

- **Alternate with water:** Drink a glass of water between alcoholic drinks.
- **Eat before and while drinking:** Food slows alcohol absorption and helps replace lost nutrients.
- **Pace yourself:** Limit intake and drink slowly so your body can process it.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXX0QmvOtvjjQThWNShom_zcUjUE-kXOVUlHCzpemG7ZBdiHtYdrDoOSROPcfabkvOtIxNJQgNxRAcXD0JP2HBwWfVm0Am581w9e2p9Q0NHWj8CCfJm9NDdC8L3zL2eQD9pthYduMwXpaDZEjZYKztRxma0)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXX9b_7usm47XTJe182kDmhBAlJ-vrBjQq1AKUn83qvq-w68Qjr3yeQVJ7PgAIVRLV2RaHjd1uegdtAXItf2l5XJfk_Yi2JgZ7CJscXX1wTNtVnojfD4EfJbtO0aTwB0I1sGc_xuNkGwSvBnVPQT2Zb_Whm3Q3I4-etar4)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESygEBxCJF179M0CGshq9wDNDeybPiA33u_E88w51VL0DAb5nWTRWcRVaKZUirWrZ-NKWN5dK8jnHXvIZCKUEfDaBXLooN0ZTjpkUrP3BNbQwwBbXJMjpP9Y3CWPUalgWargXRtM8VV8fISJWn9oogpVdj69vVuvY4stAJ4z_112iwTVfpMkTnHY04NCrGZLT-z_KUWjwwpac2j0JrvSOWx_qnZqgGU6k5eRSVvSg2Mr1lJVVVjMTcBqiVn6BpOqCgj2agaADs_MvB-tdO)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXX2qcvQnvX85kmpl9LO09a1mIhh2l3w_EEk2BUHywp4oBQT_0g5vSjF353EfH_hn_RsmvB7HcMLTPs2m-jnltgnE2bmm9FNZDBY5fpYqZOur0oGH-9n7AKblV68_hp0iBMUre8u8jXzOYwX-vpdnahiFqNag)
